quote: Our multi-table QA model, MultiTabQA, ... generates a final table as answer. ... We train a neural model to mimic a semantic parser and generate the answer. ... The model always generates a table, T_out, which can be single celled for scalar answers, single rowed or columned for list-based answers, and multiple rows and columns for tabular answers.
Our multi-table QA model generates structured tables imposed by multi-table operations.
We frame multi-table question answering as a sequence-to-sequence task and train an autoregressive transformer encoder-decoder model to generate the tabular answer.
outputs: tabular answers (structured tables with headers and values)

quote: We define table exact match Accuracy (Table EM) as the percentage of predicted tables which exactly matches the target tables. ... We evaluate partial correctness with exact match of rows, columns and cells. ... Row exact match ... Column exact match ... Cell exact match ...

We define table exact match Accuracy (Table EM) as the percentage of predicted tables which exactly matches the target tables. We also evaluate row exact match, column exact match, and cell exact match with precision, recall and F1.
We introduce table generation metrics that capture different levels of granularity and strictness to evaluate our proposed model.
